_comment: Copy this to config.json and fill in. config.json is gitignored — the login never gets committed.
_source: 'live' is the real thing: data/board.<season>.json, written by the pick box in the app. That is the board — there is no shared sheet and nothing to connect to. 'local' instead replays data/board.local.json, the complete 2025 draft kept as a test fixture; the board is read-only in that mode and the server refuses to write picks.
_localLimit: Replay mode only. Stops the 2025 fixture after N picks, so a mid-draft state can be tested without hand-editing a board file.
_pollMs: How often the board file is re-read. Every write already recomputes and pushes immediately; this is the safety net that catches the file being edited by hand.
_season: Which season the APP DISPLAYS — it reads players.<season>.json, branches.<season>.json, inventory.<season>.json and board.<season>.json. Separate from what `npm run refresh` pulls, which is always the current year. Switching seasons means this key plus those files for that year.
_ffb: thefantasyfootballers.com login, used only by `npm run refresh` to pull your UDK rankings. Never leaves this machine.

ffb._scoringSystem: Which UDK ranking set to pull. One of: STD (4pt QB), STD (6pt QB), HALF (4pt QB), HALF (6pt QB), PPR (4pt QB), PPR (6pt QB). James's league is half-PPR with 6-point passing TDs.
